source: Captured SQL Server cached plans and cumulative sys.dm_exec_query_stats; no SQL/host action performed for this review
limitations: Plan operator row counts and missing-index impact are optimizer estimates; average CPU/elapsed/reads are measured execution statistics.
Interim cumulative cache statistics are not endpoint percentiles and may include warmup.
Docker SQL CPU percentages sum across cores; 800% means approximately 8 cores.
2 GiB SQL engine memory target on local Docker is not a production capacity estimate.
